verdict.rationale: Paddle runs an official hosted MCP server (sandbox and live endpoints, OAuth or API key). Its docs say users can 'ask an agent in natural language' to handle pricing, failed-payment investigation, refunds, subscription changes, reporting and webhook setup instead of using the dashboard or API. A codemode search/execute interface covers the full API, and official plugins bundle this for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed; a native natural-language interface inside the dashboard itself (it requires an external agent client); and built-in gating of destructive operations.
